device.basis: Second audio serial-port register block (sibling of 0xfff4f000, with audio-fifo-1-transmit at +0x04). The firmware writes 1 to +0x01c and waits for bit 0 of +0x01c to read 0; the command completes at once and clears bit 0. Other words read back their last write; nothing else in this block is modeled.
